messages: It seems like #b#p221##k in #b#m10001000##k wants to test whether I'm worthy of receiving her teachings.
#m10001000#'s #b#p221# gave me a letter to deliver it to the #b#p227##k, who I should be able to find somewhere on #b#m10001090##k. She said I'd learn the rest of the details there.
On #b#m10001090##k, I met the #b#p227##k. She said she would test whether I was worthy of making the 2nd job advancement. Great! I told her I was ready for anything!
name: Finding the Instructor
